name: SalSon Logistics - Savannah GA
type: Drayage Terminal / Crossdock Warehouse + Container Yard

fieldNotes.location: 1501 Lissner Ave, Savannah GA 31408 — confirmed via Colliers/LoopNet commercial listing describing the property as a 'Truck Terminal / Container Yard with Crossdock Warehouse', 3.75 acres, 7,800 SF crossdock with 28 dock doors (expandable to 34), 2,550 SF office. SalSon-branded tractors and Ryder trailers visible in Street View along Lissner Ave. The neighboring red-brick TForce office building is a separate property.
fieldNotes.truckGate: 2018 Street View shows a chain-link sliding/swing gate across the yard driveway with a STOP sign — controlled entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the gate; the office is the small warehouse building itself. Gate is uncontrolled-by-booth, implying kiosk/call-in check-in (remoteGs true).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Colliers listing states 28 dock doors; z20 satellite shows ~12-15 containers backed in along the visible warehouse face — band 25-50 per the listing figure.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large open container/trailer yard wraps the building on multiple sides; 50+ containers/trailers staged in the wider imagery.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Honest estimate from z18/z20 imagery — roughly 50-60 containers and trailers across the SalSon yard and adjacent overflow.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short gravel/paved approach from Lissner Ave into the yard; little stacking depth before the dock face.
